title: Dental PPO Plans Member Desk Guide: Pre-Treatment Estimates Requested Anew
content:
A member of the Dental PPO Plans may request anew a pre-treatment estimate for a procedure that the person's most recently issued estimate line already priced. On an enrollment whose benefit period starts on 1 January, the estimate-request rule figures the estimated patient cost of such a request as if the procedure were performed on the issue date.

## Scope
- Figured under the base estimate rules instead: an estimate on an enrollment whose plan has changed; an estimate that a frequency or age limit would decline; an estimate for a child whose subscriber has two or more children enrolled on individual exchange enrollments; and an estimate on an account with more than three enrolled persons.
- For the frequency test of a requested estimate, an earlier paid or reprocessed implant line of the person counts against the implant interval only when it carries the same procedure code on the same tooth position, so an implant body, its abutment and its implant-supported crown each run their own interval.

## When the figures can be worked out
An estimate's figures are worked out only after the person's most recently decided claim line that was denied for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date, a waiting period the person's earlier DHMO enrollment has already served, has been reprocessed.

Put the other way: while that line still stands as the waiting-period denial it received, the estimate's figures are not yet worked out. The person's earlier DHMO enrollment is the person's own terminated enrollment in Cascade's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans, matched by name and date of birth, that ended on the day before the Dental PPO enrollment's coverage effective date.

## The request tool: `submit_estimate_request_d87add4f`
**Capability.** The member, in person, submits a pre-treatment estimate request for one proposed procedure on their Dental PPO enrollment, and the estimate is issued at once with the figures entered: one estimate line is recorded with today's request and issue date, a newly generated estimate reference, the proposed procedure, tooth, network, proposed fee, allowance, estimated plan payment, estimated patient cost, outcome remark and the last date of service it applies to. Afterwards the member can quote the estimate reference to the practice.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_estimate_request_d87add4f` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `dental_plan_id` | Reference number of the member's dental PPO enrollment the estimate is for, as returned by the dental enrollment lookup |
| `cdt_code` | Proposed procedure code: D followed by 4 digits (ADA CDT code) |
| `procedure_category` | Cascade benefit category of the proposed procedure (values below) |
| `tooth_or_area` | Tooth number 1 to 32, primary tooth letter A to T, quadrant UR, UL, LR or LL, or FM for full mouth |
| `network_status` | Network the estimate is computed under (values below) |
| `proposed_fee` | Fee the practice proposed for the procedure, USD with 2 decimal places |
| `estimated_allowed` | Allowance the estimate is computed on, USD with 2 decimal places |
| `estimated_plan_payment` | Estimated plan payment, USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `estimated_member_cost` | Estimated patient cost, USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `estimate_remark` | Outcome remark printed on the estimate (values below) |
| `valid_through` | Last date of service the estimate applies to, YYYY-MM-DD |

`procedure_category` values: `exam` (oral evaluation), `prophylaxis` (cleaning), `bitewing_xray` (bitewing films), `full_mouth_xray` (full-mouth series or panoramic film), `fluoride` (topical fluoride), `sealant`, `filling_amalgam` (amalgam filling), `filling_composite_posterior` (tooth-colored filling on a back tooth), `filling_composite_anterior` (tooth-colored filling on a front tooth), `extraction_simple`, `extraction_surgical`, `emergency_palliative` (palliative emergency treatment), `root_canal` (endodontic therapy), `scaling_root_planing`, `perio_maintenance` (periodontal maintenance), `crown`, `bridge` (fixed bridge), `denture`, `implant`, `cosmetic_other` (cosmetic or other services).

`network_status` values: `in_network_ppo` when the practice holds a Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement in force; `in_network_premier` when it holds a Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement in force and the plan has Premier access; `out_of_network` when neither applies.

`estimate_remark` values: `ESTIMATE_COVERED` (estimated as covered at its own allowance); `ESTIMATE_ALTERNATE_BENEFIT` (estimated on the allowance of an alternate procedure); `ESTIMATE_WAITING_PERIOD` (a waiting period has not run); `ESTIMATE_NOT_COVERED` (the procedure is not covered by the plan); `ESTIMATE_FREQUENCY_LIMIT` (a frequency or interval limit is exceeded); `ESTIMATE_MISSING_TOOTH` (the missing-tooth clause applies). `VOID_COVERAGE_ENDED` and `VOID_PRACTICE_REQUEST` are used only on voided estimates and never on a new request.

**Return.** On success, a text record with: `status` ("estimate_issued"), `dental_estimate_id` (reference of the estimate line), `estimate_number` (estimate reference printed on the estimate), `estimated_plan_payment` and `estimated_member_cost` (USD, 2 decimals), `issued_date` and `valid_through` (YYYY-MM-DD).
